title: Elux Firerose 5000 Cherry Sours 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cherry Sours from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection is a delightful fruit candy blend that captures the bold pop of sweet cherries with a playful sour twist. The primary flavour is a rich, sweet cherry that tantalizes the taste buds with its natural and fruity sweetness. This is intricately paired with the tangy taste of sour candy, adding a zesty edge that balances the sweetness of the cherries and creates a truly memorable vape. This unique combination of sweet cherry and sour candy is an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy bold and vibrant flavours. It offers a delicious contrast between the natural fruitiness of cherries and the exciting, tongue-tingling sensation of sour candy, resulting in a vaping experience that is both indulgent and refreshingly different. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
